Style notes for the newsletter: use a comma before the final item in a list. Use a period inside quotation marks. An exclamation point is fine in headlines, but never in the body text. A question mark should only be used for real questions, not for polite requests. If a sentence needs a colon, make sure what follows is a complete thought.
